name: kf-vestibule
prompt:
First-person point of view standing in the cold, cramped vestibule (tambour) between two carriages of an old night train. Right in front of the camera is the train's exterior door with a small window covered in thick white frost. On the frosted glass, pressed from the OUTSIDE, is a pale handprint, and behind it the faint blurred silhouette of an old man's face. Bluish moonlight seeps through the frost, one dim caged lamp above, riveted metal floor plates, cold haze. Eerie and silent.

Style: Stop-motion animation film still. Handcrafted miniature set and clay puppets with visible fingerprints, felt and wool costumes, glass bead eyes, slightly uneven handmade surfaces and tiny props. Practical miniature lighting, shallow depth of field, 35mm cinematic lens, light atmospheric haze. Eerie but whimsical dark fairy tale mood, muted teal shadows and warm amber lamp light.

name: kf-dining
prompt:
First-person point of view inside an empty old dining car of a night train. Warm amber table lamps with fringed shades, white tablecloths, every table empty. On the nearest table a glass of steaming tea in an ornate metal tea-glass holder (podstakannik) stands next to an old cardboard train ticket. In the dark window beside that table the REFLECTION shows the old passenger: the same stop-motion puppet old man as in the reference, long grey beard, deep-set glinting eyes, worn grey wool coat sitting at this very table, but the real chair in front of the camera is empty.
